front: Please do this work inside the room. (polite, formal)
hindi: Kamre ke andar ye kaam kijiye.

front: Put the guitar behind the amplifier. (informal, tum)
hindi: Guitar amplifier ke peeche rakho.

front: Please sit inside near the window. (polite, formal)
hindi: Khidkee ke paas andar baithiye.

front: Walk forward slowly. (informal, tum)
hindi: Aage aahista chalo.

front: Did anyone talk to you at the office today? (informal, m)
hindi: Kya aaj office me kisi ne tumse baat ki?

front: That song goes something like "badum dum dum".
hindi: Vo gaana kuch "badum dum dum" jaisa bajta hai.

front: Siemens pays according to old budgets, not according to GenAI experts' talent!
hindi: Siemens puraane budget ke hisaab se pay karta hai, na ki GenAI experts ke talent ke hisaab se!
target_focus: Present Continuous (-rahaa hoon) or Present Habitual (-taa hoon)

front: I am 25 years old. (informal, m)
hindi: Meri umar 25 saal hai.

front: My son is 4 years old and I am 6 months 2 weeks pregnant. (f)
hindi: Mere bete ki umar 4 saal hai aur main 6 maheene 2 hafte pregnant hoon.

front: This is my brother's new car.
hindi: Ye mere bhai ki nayi gaadi hai.

front: How is Josh's job at Revolut?
hindi: Revolut me Josh ki job kaisi hai?

front: Is that your acoustic guitar? (polite, formal, f)
hindi: Kya vo aapki acoustic guitar hai?

front: When do you have to leave? (formal)
hindi: Aapko kab nikalnaa hai?

front: Tomorrow I will have to catch the train. (m)
hindi: Kal mujhe train pakadna padegaa.

front: Can I come inside? (polite, m)
hindi: Kya main andar aa saktaa hoon?

front: Taking photos here is forbidden.
hindi: Yahaan photo lenaa manaa hai.

front: Coming inside is prohibited.
hindi: Andar aanaa manaa hai.

front: I have to attend daily morning team meetings. (habitual, m)
hindi: Mujhe daily morning team meetings attend karna padtaa hai.

front: Tomorrow we will have to leave early for the station.
hindi: Kal humein station ke liye jaldi nikalna padegaa.

front: Can I ask you a question? (formal, m)
hindi: Kya main aapse ek question pooch saktaa hoon?

front: My mom has to cook food for our family every day.
hindi: Meri mummy ko humare pariwar ke liye har din khana banaana padtaa hai.

front: We have to get ready early tomorrow morning.
hindi: Humein kal subah jaldi ready hona hai.

front: I am about to start the new AI script. (speaker m)
hindi: Main naya AI script start karne wala hoon.
target_focus: Agentive/Aspectual marker -vaalaa ('about to' / 'the one that is')
